message.content: The “best” movie of 2020 can vary depending on who you ask—critics, audiences, or specific genres—but many consider **“Parasite”** (though it was released in 2019, it dominated 2020 awards circuits) and **“Tenet”** (Christopher Nolan’s 2020 thriller) as standout films. If you’re looking for a 2020 release that received widespread acclaim, **“The Trial of the Chicago 7”** (directed by Aaron Sorkin) and **“Soul”** (Disney/Pixar’s heartfelt animated feature) were both highly praised. Ultimately, the “best” film depends on your taste—whether you prefer political drama, sci‑fi action, or animated storytelling.
